name: Mapbox
sub: Developer-first maps powering fleet and mobility interfaces
leadership: Peter Sirota, CEO reported; Eric Gundersen, founder
about: Developer-first mapping, navigation and location platform used across mobility, logistics and automotive interfaces, less focused on Level 4 HD mapping than HERE/TomTom.
model: Usage-based SaaS APIs, SDKs, navigation and map services.
metrics: Not an AV-driver core supplier, but relevant for commercial/demand-layer map UX and fleet products
signal: Useful demand and developer layer, especially for mobility apps and fleet software
